notes.title: We are finally live! 😎
notes.notes:
Hello! 😀

Just wanted to let everyone know that I'm actively monitoring for bug reports from players.
Basically, I'm here waiting in the wings, ready to fix stuff. 

Apologies in advance if anything goes really really wrong.

Cheers, and thanks for playing!!
